prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: genuine fashion research moodboard for a stylist developing a versatile contemporary everyday tailored jacket. Create ONE landscape image showing a curated physical fashion inspiration collage on plain off-white paper, photographed flat from directly above. The collage must clearly consist of 8 to 10 DISTINCT overlapping irregular rectangular paper clippings and actual tactile swatches, with breathing space and intentional visual hierarchy. Include: 3 tactile fabric swatches (wool twill closeup with frayed edge, cotton, linen); 2 cropped editorial fashion photographs showing jacket shoulder/lapel proportions and relaxed tailoring on a person (crop out the face and head; these are reference garments, not a definitive new design); 1 closeup of a hand sewing a jacket seam; 1 detail photo of matte buttons beside thread; 1 restrained everyday city fashion street photograph cropped to clothing in motion. Palette: camel wool, ivory cotton, sand linen, taupe, warm charcoal; understated everyday tailoring. These should be inspiration fragments with different crops, scales and textures, pasted together by a fashion stylist, not one continuous scene. Realistic editorial photography and tangible fabric texture. No hotel, room, furniture, architecture, building, courtyard, pool, vase, landscape, interior decoration, sculpture. No fashion drawings, figurines, croquis, blueprint, finished design presentation, logo, caption, words, labels, color palette blocks or interface. No hands arranging the board. Portraits must be incidental cropped garment references only. The overall result must read unmistakably as a FASHION MOODBOARD, tactile and exploratory, not a hotel photograph. Landscape 3:2 image.
